title: URAファイナルズ予選にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The URA Finale is a stage upon which all Umamusume can shine.
At long last, the day of the preliminaries has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you for seeing <chrname> off.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You've finally made it this far. As a fan, I'm elated.
choice_data_list: We'll make it one for the history books!

text_block_list.text: Heheheh, I've no doubt. I'm looking forward to the race!
The gates will fly open any minute now… URA Finale, here we come!
